name: [LOCAL] Improve Context & Memory Content
description: Curate operator-specific context and memory CONTENT: Firestore project context (projects/), core memory entries (core_memory/), MEMORY.md facts. The on-demand cousin of p-memory-consolidate. No repo changes — all writes go to Firestore or the operator/ overlay.

steps.title: Investigate content
steps.description: Read project context (project-manage get), core memory entries (core-memory-read --all), and MEMORY.md. Cross-reference with recent mission outputs. Identify stale facts, missing context, duplicate entries, and incorrect information.
steps.accept_criteria: List of content issues: stale facts (with source), missing context (with evidence from missions), duplicates.

steps.title: Operator confirms corrections
steps.description: Present the proposed corrections to the operator. The operator is the authority on their own context — they confirm what is stale, what is missing, and what the correct values are.
steps.approval_message: 📋 Context & Memory content review. I found these issues in your project context and core memory. Please confirm which corrections to make, adjust any values, and approve.
steps.accept_criteria: Operator confirmed or adjusted the proposed corrections.

steps.title: Curate via Firestore tools
steps.description: Apply the operator-approved corrections: update project context (project-manage update/add-context), retire stale core memory (core-memory-retire), write corrected facts (core-memory-write). Record every document path written.
steps.accept_criteria: All corrections applied. Document paths recorded.

steps.title: Land via local-improvement skill
steps.description: Land per the local-improvement skill: verify no platform files were modified, no PR was opened. Report the Firestore document paths.
steps.accept_criteria: No platform files touched. No PR. Document paths reported.
